notes.title: The update is here!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]We are excited to present new features and improvements in Sharded World: Backpack Adventure that will make your journey even more comfortable and engaging![/h3][/b]

[b]What's New:[/b]
[b]Tutorial for New Players:[/b] A step-by-step tutorial is now available to help you master every stage of the game.

[b]We’ll guide you through each element of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Explain how items work and how to make the most of them.
[*] Show you how to interact with your backpack and the items within it.
[*] Teach you how the store works so you can buy the resources and upgrades you need.
[/list]
And much more to make your dive into the game world as engaging and comfortable as possible.

[b]For Experienced Players:[/b] If you already know the game inside out, the tutorial can be easily turned off or restarted in the settings menu.

[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs to make the gameplay even more stable.
[*] Performance optimization for smoother gameplay.
[*] Minor interface tweaks for improved usability.
[/list]
[h3][b]🎄 Happy Holidays!
Dear players, we wish you a wonderful holiday season! May your journey in Sharded World and beyond be filled with bright, joyful moments.

We raise a mug of ale in the tavern for you and your achievements! May the new year bring you light-filled days and inspiring moments.[/b][/h3]

🔍 Check out the game to explore all the new features!
Your feedback and suggestions always help us improve. Join the community discussions and share your thoughts about the update!

Thank you for staying with us. Happy adventuring and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Big Localization Update
notes.notes:
We are excited to present a major update for Sharded World: Backpack Adventure. We have improved many aspects of the game to make your adventure even more exciting. Here are the main changes:

[h3][b]Multilingual Support[/b][/h3]
Sharded World is now available in Ukrainian, Russian and Simplified Chinese.
[list]
[*] All texts in the game, including menus, item descriptions, and hints, are fully translated.
[*] You can select the appropriate language in the settings menu.
[*] This update makes the game accessible to a wider audience worldwide.
[/list]

[h3][b]Knowledge Book Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Knowledge Book now shows how many recipes you have unlocked and the total number of available recipes.
[*] This feature will help you better track your progress and effectively plan the study of new recipes.
[*] Visual improvements
[*] We have changed and improved some aspects of the game’s visual design. These changes make the game more comfortable and aesthetically pleasing.
[/list]

[h3][b]Technical Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Some bugs and visual issues have been fixed.
[*] Optimization has been carried out to enhance the stability and performance of the game.
[/list]

[h3][b]Global Changes to the Game[/b][/h3]
We are temporarily suspending the tournament as we prepare a major update that will affect all aspects of the game.
[list]
[*] This update will serve as the foundation for a new chapter in the development of Sharded World.
[*] We are working on new mechanics, elements, and features that will make the gameplay even more engaging and immersive.
[/list]
Thank you for your support and interest in Sharded World! We continue to improve the game to meet the highest quality standards. Stay tuned for updates on upcoming changes. Your adventure is just beginning!

notes.title: New Hotfix for Sharded World: Backpack Adventure!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, adventurers! We've released a small but crucial update to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the main fixes and changes we've implemented:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Ranked Game Save Issue Fixed: Resolved an issue where progress was not being saved after ranked matches.
[*] Adventurer Talent Fix: Corrected a bug where the money-earning talent was not functioning properly. Now, money will be credited correctly.
[*] Balancing the Hive: Adjustments have been made to the hive to ensure a fairer and more engaging gameplay.
[*] New Salt Shaker Recipe: Added a recipe for a salt shaker, which will open up new culinary possibilities within the game.
[*] Minor Fixes: Various small fixes have been made to improve stability and performance of the game.
[/list]

[h3][b]We hope these changes make your adventure even more enjoyable and exciting. Thank you for your support and active participation in the life of Sharded World: Backpack Adventure! Be sure to update the game to enjoy the improved gameplay.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Legendary update
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Dear players!
We are excited to introduce our most expansive and innovative update yet! Prepare for unique innovations that will elevate your gameplay to a new level.[/h3][/b]

[b]Here’s what awaits you in the new version of the game:[/b]

[b]New items with unique mechanics:[/b] Enjoy a plethora of new items, some featuring the unique "Intoxication" mechanic. These items and mechanics will not only diversify your gameplay but also allow you to explore new strategies and combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/6c42422040a993aca0c8c68a030b624e90917fc0.gif[/img]

[b]Enhanced customization options:[/b] You can now deeply customize your gaming interface and elements. Express your individuality and creativity by creating a unique gaming space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/b7e7ada68000bf0f7edfa30c7fef6f853297b16c.gif[/img]

[b]New achievements and rewards:[/b] We have added many new achievements, each offering unique rewards. Show off your skills and earn exclusive customization items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/6cf6a3b6289c096cf682ea7d8912ee4e356cb5fa.gif[/img]

[b]Daily Quest:[/b] Earn customization coins by completing new daily missions. This is a great way to continuously develop and refresh your game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/d2d192f6251e5fb96ae0602b937987fc01408620.gif[/img]

[b]Updated leaderboard window:[/b] The revamped window is not only functional but also allows you to display your individual customization. Show off your achievements and style to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/b64b392dc4c7f9e845a4b9784b3107a9a8c96c65.jpg[/img]

[b]Interface and menu improvements:[/b] We have redesigned the settings, pause menu, and knowledge book, making them more user-friendly and intuitive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/117dd9c17c39633b0e0a3f00629d242e3e7a3e14.gif[/img]

[b]New animations and sounds:[/b] Enjoy improved visualization with new character animations and weapon visuals in combat, as well as new sound effects that make the game even more vivid and rich.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/31ab3421cd0318743acd71596614eccc0d90dad7.gif[/img]

[b]Improvements in PvP mode:[/b] We have fixed bugs in PvP mode and conducted a minor redesign. We have also added a match history with a rematch request feature, allowing you to immediately seek revenge for a defeat or defend your victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/73e7ae83289c509d9d02fe777117329fc072bedd.gif[/img]

[b]Improved tooltip system:[/b] The new tooltip system will help you navigate the game more quickly and effectively, providing useful information on the go.

[b]Bug fixes and balance improvements:[/b] We have carefully listened to community feedback and implemented numerous bug fixes and balance adjustments to ensure a fairer and more comfortable gameplay experience.

[b][h3]We invite you to join our adventure and experience all these improvements firsthand! Log into the game, try out the new features, and share your feedback. Your input is incredibly important to us as we strive to make Sharded World: Backpack Adventure better with every update.

Don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to support us and not miss any future updates!

Thank you for being with us. Enjoy your game![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Legendary Update!
notes.notes:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that we have finally installed portals between dungeons. Starting today, players have access to real-time battles with other players. Now, you can purchase and collect items right in the midst of battle, basing your choice on the strategy of your opponent.[/b]

[b][h3]Multiplayer is Here![/h3][/b]
Now you can invite a friend to the lobby or find an opponent in real-time. This opens up new possibilities for competition and strategic planning.

[b][h3]What is it? And How to Play?[/h3][/b]
In the main menu, you'll find a PvP button that will lead you to the lobby. Choose your hero and backpack, just like in the regular game. However, by inviting a friend or finding an opponent among players, a whole new world of real-time gameplay opportunities opens up for you. You can adapt your actions by purchasing items according to your opponent's build, counter their play style, etc. Dominate the battlefield! Select the best items, develop a strategy, and achieve victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/47abcd25970d0001a89b49b301aac12d736f7345.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Shop Update![/h3][/b]
Due to the incompetence of the previous shop owner, we had to put in a lot of effort to find and appoint a new owner. The new owner possesses unique interdimensional magic, which significantly saves on logistics. As the shopkeeper's level increases, he will be able to offer items of higher rarity and in greater quantity. Moreover, in the game settings, you can now disable the auto-upgrade feature of the shopkeeper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/110434267693d13b91331b573fa53ec11e31414a.gif[/img]
[b][h3]Other Changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Game errors have been corrected and fixed to improve stability and the quality of the gameplay.
[*] Work on improving balance and gameplay continues to ensure the fairest and most exciting battles.
[/list]
[b]We are confident that these improvements will make your adventures even more thrilling and unpredictable. May each update open new horizons and opportunities for exploration before you. We wish you luck in conquering new peaks and achieving new victories![/b]

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Greetings, heroes! We've released an update that will make your adventure even more thrilling:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] Item Descriptions Rework: We've improved the texts to help you better understand the purpose of each item.

[*] Updated Tooltips: Now, they contain detailed information about DPS and other per-second parameters, aiding you in strategic choices.

[*] Misses and Status Notifications: We've added clear alerts for misses and moments when your stamina or mana is running low.

[*] Hedgehog Bug Fix: Fixed a game crash when two hedgehogs meet: Some of you encountered an unexpected game exit during encounters between two hedgehogs on the battlefield. We're pleased to report that our hedgehogs have found common ground and now live peacefully, eliminating such crashes in the future.
[/list]

[b][h3]Dive into the updated world of our game and enjoy the new features![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Major Pet Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, heroes and adventurers! For this update, we've scoured every nook and cranny of the dungeon and gathered a multitude of different and rare creatures to assist you in your battles. Who will be accompanying you on your journey?[/h3]

[b][h3]More Chickens![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/a74e803add967c3e9ab6e2e303be6a708e3e9bae.png[/img]
In the dungeon, we stumbled upon a goblin farmer who was training his chickens for future battles. More chickens mean more opportunities! In addition to the regular chicken and the golden one, you now have access to:
[list]
[*] [b]Armored Chicken[/b] - a faithful companion in steel armor ready to take a hit for you.
[*] [b]Knight Chicken[/b] - always there to rescue its master when it's time to deliver a crude frontal attack.
[*] [b]Spartan Chicken[/b] - hardened by tough training and endless battles. What can we say? This is Sparta!
[*] [b]Priest Chicken[/b] - not only carries the word of God but also serves as an excellent helper in difficult situations.
[*] [b]Wizard Chicken[/b] - its abilities are incredible, a great find for those who rely on magic.
[*] [b]Hawaiian Chicken[/b] - came here from those glorious times when faces were scarred and parties were loud across the town!
[/list]
[b][h3]Wild Animals![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/ae783837836dbb2d36d9f3d6d51800c798e08c55.png[/img]
Wandering through the endless tunnels, we encountered wild animals that had accidentally wandered in, which will surely help you in your journey to the top of the food chain!
[list]
[*] [b]Boar[/b] - very aggressive, has thick skin and sharp tusks, and can also be ridden, but it's better not to.
[*] [b]Magic Boar[/b] - once, when it was a little piglet, it fell into a cauldron of magic potion and now possesses unknown power!
[*] [b]Hedgehog[/b] - so cute that we almost ate it, but we were stopped by its mighty and sharp quills that pierce flesh!
[*][b]Snake[/b] - at first we thought it was a rope until it bit one of our explorers!
[*] [b]Golden Unicorn[/b] - we weren't looking for it, it came to us. A very rare creature.
[/list]
[b][h3]EVEN MORE SLIME FOR THE SLIME GOD![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/5fb7fe86fdd518cab3d5569ad8524916255734ae.png[/img]
In addition to the main hero and his brethren, the calmest floors are home to foolish slimes without personality or consciousness. We use them for various tasks: battles, explosions, arson, sock washing...
[list]
[*] [b]Ordinary Slime[/b] - a soulless heap of gelatinous mass, but even it can find a use.
[*] [b]Toxic Slime[/b] - by absorbing various kinds of poisons and diseases, it has become a biological weapon!
[*][b] Luck Slime[/b] - a rare species that accidentally swallowed a leprechaun, brings luck!
[*] [b]Gluttony Slime[/b] - its only goal in its senseless life is to devour everything that lies on the ground and floats in the air.
[*] [b]Fire Slime[/b] - appears in places where temperatures exceed hundreds of degrees, and lava flows like rivers.
[*] [b]Weapon Absorbing Slime[/b] - in places where heroes drop their gear to run away faster, it remains to feed on metal alone.
[*] [b]Aggressive Slime[/b] - imbued with malice through and through, a great way to charge up with battle fury!
[*] [b]Protection Slime[/b] - surprisingly noble creatures that have taken heroes as their role models.
[/list]
[b][h3]Other Changes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] 21 new items in the game.
[*] Added new features for items.
[*] Found a broken item that led to crashes (automatic crossbow). This situation will no longer occur.
[*] Added more useful information on elements in the form of tooltips.
[*] Knowledge book expanded with new pets.
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[/list]

[b][h3]Online Mode Announcement![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/47abcd25970d0001a89b49b301aac12d736f7345.gif[/img]


[b][h3]We are also excited to announce that soon you will have the opportunity to battle one-on-one with your friend or a random player here and now. This mode is created to test your strength in battle in real-time. Make decisions on combinations of defense and attack at the moment to defeat your opponent. We have already tested this mode; only a bit of polishing is left to ensure you don't encounter any difficulties.[/h3][/b]

We sincerely hope that this extensive pet update brings a new level of excitement and enjoyment to your gameplay. With a plethora of new companions to choose from, whether it be the armored might of a chicken in steel armor or the mystical allure of a golden unicorn, we believe these additions will not only enhance your adventures but also bring a fresh layer of strategy and fun to your battles.

Our aim is to continuously enrich your experience, making every dungeon crawl and battle more engaging and rewarding. Look forward to even more dynamic interactions and thrilling challenges in the upcoming multiplayer update. Until then, may your journeys be filled with victory and discovery. See you in the next chapter of our ever-evolving game world!

notes.title: small update!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Welcome, brave adventurers!

We are excited to announce a minor yet significant update designed to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a brief overview of the main changes:[/h3][/b]

[b][h2]Tooltips and Interface[/h2][/b]
[list][*] Now, by holding down the tooltip, you can fix it in place and examine the provided information in detail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/8a0e98a276c7e4b2c47ea40afa8200a5b7319210.gif[/img]
[*] The tagging system has been optimized: if there are multiple tags on an item, hovering over it will reveal the rest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/36fc1aa98705fe9e51711fa7779060083adba143.gif[/img]
[*] Hovering over stats now provides more detailed information.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/12297bb123711fbc3761df6b3c86df5dfede2f22.gif[/img]
[*] A setting has been added that allows tooltips to be fixed in place only with a mouse wheel click, rather than automatically attaching after a delay.
[/list]

[b][h2]Game Balance and Items[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Incorrectly functioning items have been corrected.
[*] A cooldown limit has been introduced: items cannot be activated more frequently than once per second.
[*] Agility gloves are now available through a recipe.
[*] Game balance adjustments have been made, particularly affecting speed potions and toadstools.
[/list]

[b][h2]System Improvements[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] A system for tracking game crashes after battle initiation has been implemented.
[*] The combat system has been enriched with dynamic rendering of buffs and debuffs.
[/list]

[b][h2]Book of Knowledge[/h2][/b]
The Book of Knowledge has been updated and supplemented with missing items, making it even more detailed and useful.

We hope these improvements will make your adventure even more thrilling. May each update open new horizons and opportunities for you. Good luck in conquering new peaks!

notes.title: First update is here!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Welcome, brave adventurers!

We are excited to introduce to you an update rich in new features and improvements that make the gameplay even more thrilling and interactive.[/h3][/b]

[h2]Recipes and Book of Knowledge[/h2]
We have significantly expanded the possibilities for using recipes in the Book of Knowledge. Now, in addition to being able to unlock new recipes, you can also purchase them with rating points. As a bonus for your first recipe purchase, you will receive a small reward, making the process even more enjoyable. The Book of Knowledge has been updated to include not only improved recipe displays but also the addition of class-specific items. Moreover, by hovering over an item, you can now see its components, further simplifying the crafting process and enhancing your planning strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/677c5ad4d93665b94ad2aac557fa8a00e4219c7f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/a5a042046f7dbfd555a7b98c3e128230416c1274.gif[/img]

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]
The update introduces a new leaderboard where you can compare your achievements with the results of other players. This not only fosters healthy competition but also allows you to assess your progress and set new goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777336/9ebb9d3cf0b9bdecfe165e86a5b94810a0d1fbbe.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes and MMR System[/h2]
Special attention has been given to fixing bugs and optimizing the game to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay. Furthermore, the MMR (Matchmaking Rating) system has been revamped to provide more accurate and fair player matching, increasing the quality and intensity of competitions.

[b][h3]We are confident that these changes will make your adventure even more captivating and comfortable. May each update bring you new exciting moments and help you reach unprecedented heights. Good luck in conquering new peaks![/h3][/b]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear players, we are excited to announce that the time has come for you to enjoy the project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664470/Sharded_World_Backpack_Adventure/]"Sharded World: Backpack Adventure"[/url]. This is a game where you can demonstrate your tactical skills, unconventional thinking, and just have fun defeating your opponents.
[/h3]

[h2][b]What awaits you?[/b][/h2]

[h3]- The ability to equip your character for battle. Currently, there are two classes available in the game: adventurer and sorceress.
- A starting backpack with a minimal set of items. Upon visiting the shop, you will be able to collect your first recipes by purchasing the missing items and head into battle.
- In battle, you will encounter players with a wide variety of backpack combinations. Gradually, you will need to build defense against different types of damage, as well as remember to strike at the enemy yourself.[/h3]

[h3]Devise your tactics, combine talents and items, become invincible, and progress through the ranking system, facing more experienced players in battle!

Don't miss the chance to be among the first to try the game and share your opinion with the developers! Your feedback will help us make the game even better.

[b]Join the adventure today and start your journey to the top of the rankings in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664470/Sharded_World_Backpack_Adventure/]"Sharded World: Backpack Adventure"[/url]![/b][/h3]
